tex_content.label: prop:foundations-initial
tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Initial topology] The chosen atlas of $M$ has compatible orientation signs. There is a finite CW structure of dimension at most three on $M$, and for every $p\in M$, \[ \pi _1(M,p)=0,\qquad \pi _2(M,p)=0,\qquad \pi _3(M,p)\cong \mathbb Z. \] Moreover, $M\simeq S^3$.

↗ prop:foundations-triangulation ↗ lem:foundations-determinant-cover ↗ cor:foundations-homotopy-groups ↗ prop:foundations-cw-equivalence Source: MT2007 1. discussion after Proposition 18.9, p. 4242. discussion after Claim 18.20, p. 431

The following constructions prove this proposition. The nonzero third homotopy class supplies the width argument; orientation supplies the obstruction to a two-sided projective plane.
